candidates.source_attribution: Cyril of Alexandria, Commentary on Matthew (fragments), preserved in J.A. Cramer, Catenae Graecorum Patrum in Novum Testamentum, Vol. I: In Evangelia S. Matthaei et S. Marci (Oxford: University Press, 1840). PD. Greek text also in PG 72 cols. 365-474.
candidates.draft_body:
Cyril of Alexandria Commentary on Matthew (c. 430 AD)
